ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נִשְׁאַר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן עִם מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob stayed in Canaan with his father, unlike Esau who moved to Mount Seir.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף קִבֵּל יַחַס מְיֻחָד מֵאָבִיו, וְהָאַחִים קִנְּאוּ בּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The story focuses on Joseph, loved by his father, given a special coat and reporting about his brothers, which made them jealous and angry.

ideas.children_he: הַחֲלוֹמוֹת שֶׁל יוֹסֵף הִגְבִּירוּ אֶת הַמְּתִיחוּת בֵּין הָאַחִים.
ideas.children_en: Joseph dreamed dreams that made his brothers hate him more because they thought he wanted to rule over them.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים חֲלוֹם גּוֹרֵם לָנוּ לַחְשֹׁב עַל הֶעָתִיד.
ideas.children_en: Joseph dreamed another dream including his parents and brothers, and Jacob remembered the dream even though he thought it wouldn't come true.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף יָצָא לְחַפֵּשׂ אֶת אֶחָיו כִּי אָבִיו דָּאַג לָהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob sent Joseph to check on his brothers and the sheep, and Joseph found them after searching and asking a man who told him where they were.

ideas.children_he: הַכַּעַס שֶׁל הָאַחִים הָפַךְ לְתָכְנִית מְסֻכֶּנֶת.
ideas.children_en: The brothers saw Joseph alone and wanted to kill him, but Reuben suggested putting him in a pit to save him later.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לְבוֹר וְהִשְׁאִירוּ אוֹתוֹ לְבַד.
ideas.children_en: The brothers took off Joseph's special coat and threw him into an empty pit without water.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף נִמְכַּר וְנִלְקַח לְאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה. זֶה הָיָה עָוֶל גָּדוֹל.
ideas.children_en: The brothers saw a caravan of Ishmaelites and planned to sell Joseph to them; Joseph was sold and taken to Egypt.
Reuben returned to the pit, found Joseph gone, and mourned and worried about his fate.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִכְרִיחוּ אֶת עַצְמָם לְהַסְתִּיר אֶת הָאֱמֶת בְּשֶׁקֶר.
ideas.children_en: The brothers made a story using Joseph's coat stained with blood to show he was killed by a wild animal.

ideas.children_he: שֶׁקֶר יָכוֹל לִגְרֹם לְכְאֵב גָּדוֹל לַאֲנָשִׁים שֶׁאוֹהֲבִים אוֹתָנוּ.
ideas.children_en: The brothers sent Joseph's coat to Jacob for identification, making him think something bad happened to Joseph.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב חָשַׁב שֶׁיּוֹסֵף מֵת וְהָיָה עָצוּב מְאֹד.
ideas.children_en: Jacob recognized the coat and believed Joseph died by a wild animal, mourning him for many days.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים גַּם מִלּוֹת נֶחָמָה אֵינָן מַסְפִּיקוֹת כְּדֵי לְהָקֵל עַל כְּאֵב.
ideas.children_en: The family tried to comfort Jacob, but he refused and said he believes Joseph is dead.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִגִּיעַ לְמִצְרַיִם, וְהַחַיִּים שֶׁלּוֹ הִשְׁתַּנּוּ לְגַמְרֵי.
ideas.children_en: Joseph was sold in Egypt to Potiphar, an important official in Pharaoh's palace, who valued him highly.
